customMethods.script:
if workOrderEventId is None: return False
	data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderEventCheckStatus(workOrderEventId))
	
	self.view.custom.workOrderEventCheckStatus = data
	
	completed = True
	
	for row in data:
		if row['required'] and row['status'] != 'Completed':
			completed = False
			break
			
	system.perspective.print('getWorkOrderEventCheckStatus returned %s'%completed)
	
	return completed

system.perspective.print('msgHandler deleteComment() called with %s'%payload)
	workOrderEventMetaId = system.util.jsonDecode(payload['metaData']).get('workOrderEventMetaDataId')
	if workOrderEventMetaId is not None:
		system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrderEventMetaData(workOrderEventMetaId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshComments', {})
	
	return

system.perspective.print('msgHandler updateComment() called with %s'%payload)
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	workOrderEventMetaData = system.util.jsonDecode(payload['metaData'])
	
	if workOrderEventMetaData.get('workOrderEventMetaDataId') is not None:
		workOrderEventMetaDataId = system.util.jsonDecode(payload['metaData'])['workOrderEventMetaDataId']
		workOrderEventMetaInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderEventMetaData({'workOrderEventMetaDataId': workOrderEventMetaDataId}))[0]
		workOrderEventMetaInfo['metaDataValue'] = system.util.jsonEncode({'comment': payload['text'], 'pinned': payload['pinned']})
		system.kanoa.cmms.updateWorkOrderEventMetaData(workOrderEventMetaInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshComments', {})
	
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	workOrderEventMetaInfo = {

	}

	system.kanoa.cmms.addWorkOrderEventMetaData(workOrderEventMetaInfo, userId)
